description: Changes purchase behaviour: checkout options, what owning a product raises (storage, table rows) and the «firma» (Neblla's logo and a coffee-cup donation button; turning it on creates the `cafe` product at once, needs the shop module). Products and prices: neblla_create_product. Waits in the draft until neblla_promote "save" (env "pro" for the users). More: neblla_get_llms tools/update_app_payments

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, what users have) or "pre" (the private test copy); left out: the environment the developer picked for this app in the panel.

limits.description: What a purchase raises, per product id: { premium: { maxBytesPerUser, tables: { … } } }.

purchases.description: { emailCheckout }: false lets only signed-in users buy; null: the defaults.

signature.description: The «firma»: { enabled, position?, amountPreset?, thankYou? }; null removes it (the product stays).

name: neblla_update_app_payments
title: Change payment settings
